title: Gorillaz Frontman Praises Sheinbaum; Highlights Her Trip to China in Economy Class
author: Redacción/SinEmbargo
content:
_This article
by[Redacción/SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/)
originally appeared in the [November 21, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4907405/el-lider-de-gorillaz-elogia-a-
sheinbaum-destaca-su-viaje-a-china-en-clase-economica/), a Mexican digital
news outlet._

_The musician spoke about the Mexican president to more than 72,000 attendees
after waving a Palestinian flag._

**Mexico City, November 21 (SinEmbargo).–** **Damon Albarn** , lead singer and
frontman of the British band **Gorillaz** , praised President **Claudia
Sheinbaum Pardo** (**CSP**) last night during his performance at the **Corona
Capital 2026** festival, where he highlighted Mexico’s revolutionary spirit
and acknowledged the president’s decision to travel in **economy class** to
China to participate in the [Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation
(APEC)](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4905980/csp-se-reunira-con-la-directora-del-
fmi-y-primeros-ministros-de-australia-y-singapur/) summit.

> “I’m going to say this just once tonight. But I love Mexico because you have
> a revolutionary spirit. Here, it’s an inspiring country, and you know, I
> don’t know much about your
> [president](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/claudia-sheinbaum/), but the fact
> that she traveled in economy class is something really important to me… it’s
> a statement, I salute you all, I love you,” the musician told those in
> attendance.

The comment came during the first day of Corona Capital, when Gorillaz closed
the main stage’s performances before 72,344 people. Albarn’s remarks came
after he stepped down from the stage to approach the audience and took a
Palestinian flag that one of the attendees handed him.

The British singer’s words referred to Sheinbaum’s recent trip to Shenzhen,
where she participated in the [APEC 2026 summit](https://www.apec.org/), held
on November 18 and 19. To reach the international gathering, the chief
executive boarded a commercial China Southern Airlines flight and made a
journey of approximately 21 hours in economy class.

The president’s decision also drew attention in the Asian country, where users
of the social network Weibo shared images and comments about her presence on
the aircraft alongside other passengers. Some internet users even said
Sheinbaum occupied seat 33B, located toward the rear of the plane.

## Sheinbaum’s Trip Goes Viral in China

The president maintains a policy of austerity in her international travel, a
practice that began during the six-year term of her predecessor, Andrés Manuel
López Obrador (AMLO), who pushed for the sale of the presidential plane as
part of measures to reduce federal government spending.

![Claudia Sheinbaum poses with the crew of the aircraft on which she returned
to Mexico.](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/gorillaz-
sheinbaum-economy-class-body-1.jpg)The chief executive posted a photograph on
social media with the crew of the aircraft on which she traveled back to
Mexico. Photo: X @Claudiashein.

On this occasion, Sheinbaum traveled to China to hold various meetings with
leaders and representatives of other economies, including Chinese President Xi
Jinping. The agenda also included meetings with business leaders and
activities related to Mexico’s participation in the regional forum.

The president’s journey caused a sensation on various digital platforms. In
fact, a hashtag related to her arrival in Shenzhen surpassed 10 million views
on Weibo.

> "It is commendable to spend taxpayers’ money frugally and make sure it is
> used where it is needed most, rather than wasting it on luxurious private
> planes or official travel expenses," one internet user commented.
